slides.headline: Why the AI boss wants to pump the brakes
Anthropic CEO says slow down now
slides.body: Dario Amodei went public this week urging a pause on frontier AI development.

slides.headline: His three-step plan to curb risk
slides.body: Mandatory safety tests, government oversight boards, and global standards before bigger models launch.

slides.headline: Researchers warn of extinction risk
slides.body: Multiple Anthropic staff quit, saying unchecked AI could threaten humanity within years.

slides.headline: But Anthropic still ships powerful AI
slides.body: Claude models keep improving while the CEO asks for rules — critics call it talking both ways.

slides.headline: Want AI news that affects you?
slides.body: Follow for plain-English updates on what AI means for your job, money, and privacy.
